content.text:
This is a developer-run bundle analyzer CLI. Both changed files are non-security-sensitive:

1. **`scripts/analyze-bundles-cli.mjs`** — the new `getRouteOwnFiles` function only performs filesystem reads (`readdirSync`, `statSync`) under a hard-coded `projectRoot/.next/server/app` path. No shell, no eval, no network, no writes, no untrusted input reaches it. The `statSync(..., { throwIfNoEntry: false })` calls correctly return `undefined` on missing entries, so recursion behaves as intended. It's invoked from `analyzeRouteServerBundle`, which uses the CLI `--route` argument to build a path — but this is a local developer script (no server context), and even so it's read-only.

2. **`bundle-size-baseline.json`** — pure numeric/string data (byte sizes, chunk filenames). No security surface.

No entry points, no dangerous sinks introduced, no auth/policy logic touched.
